headline: Congress accepted a request from the Miami Tribe of Oklahoma to revoke its 1940 federal charter of incorporation.
what_it_does: The law accepts the tribe's request to cancel the charter of incorporation that was issued to the tribe in 1940 and ratified by its members on June 1, 1940. A charter is a federal document that set out how the tribe was organized as a legal entity. The summary does not describe what the tribe will use in its place or any other steps the law requires.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Miami Tribe of Oklahoma
who_it_affects.how: The legal charter that the tribe was organized under since 1940 is revoked at the tribe's own request.

when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 6, 2015. The summary does not list any later dates.
